title of the card: Row has the wrong number of columns
what to do (HTML): Every row needs exactly 8 columns: Sample, MID_F, MID_R, Primer, Transcript, DNAPosition, AminoAcid, PatientId. A comma inside a field splits it into two columns, a missing field shifts all following columns. Open the original sheet at the listed line numbers, fix the row and upload the sheet again. These rows are not in the corrected sheet.

Write the marker in HGVS notation: transcript with version (NM_004364.4), DNA position as c.<position><reference>><alternative> (c.23A>T), insertions as c.10_11insACG, deletions and duplications with their sequence (c.208dupC). The Problem column gives the expected form. Correct the field in the sample sheet.
label when the check passed: Notation of transcript, DNA position and protein is valid

# pattern (regular expression on the sec: Primer not in the primer table
title of the card: Primer is not in the primer table
what to do (HTML): Write the primer name exactly as in the primer table of the library. If it is a new primer, add it to the primer table first; the workflow cannot trim or assign reads of an unknown primer.
label when the check passed: Every primer is in the primer table

# pattern (regular expression on the sec: MID not in the MID file
title of the card: MID is not in the MID file
what to do (HTML): Write the MID name exactly as in the MID file (for example MID1). Reads of an unknown MID cannot be assigned to the sample.
label when the check passed: Every MID is in the MID file

# pattern (regular expression on the sec: MID combination used more than once
title of the card: MID combination is used more than once
what to do (HTML): Each sample needs its own pair of MID_F and MID_R. With the same pair the reads of the samples cannot be told apart. Check which pair was really used in the wet lab and correct the sheet.
label when the check passed: Every MID combination is used once

title of the card: Marker cannot be placed on the genome
what to do (HTML): TransVar, which the MRD workflow uses to find the marker position, does not know this transcript or position. The workflow would report no result for the sample. Compare transcript and DNA position with the diagnostic finding: the transcript version may be missing from the hg19 annotation (use the version that TransVar knows), or the position lies outside the transcript.
label when the check passed: Every marker can be placed on the genome

title of the card: Primer and transcript belong to different genes
what to do (HTML): The primer amplifies another gene than the transcript of the marker. Either the primer or the transcript is wrong. Compare both with the diagnostic finding.
label when the check passed: Primer and transcript belong to the same gene

title of the card: Primer did not match the location
what to do (HTML): The marker lies outside the region the primer amplifies, so the run cannot measure it; a 'not detected' would not be a valid result. Most often the DNA position is numbered on another transcript of the gene (CEBPA: NM_004364 and NM_001287424 differ by 105 positions). If a hint column names a transcript that fits, check the transcript in the sheet; otherwise check primer and DNA position against the diagnostic finding.
label when the check passed: Every marker lies inside the amplicon of its primer

# pattern (regular expression on the sec: does not match the transcript reference|protein differs
title of the card: DNA position or protein does not fit the transcript
what to do (HTML): The reference base of the DNA position differs from the transcript, or the protein change TransVar derives differs from the AminoAcid column. Check the DNA position, the transcript version and the protein change against the diagnostic finding.
label when the check passed: DNA position and protein fit the transcript
